primary_kappa: OLS negative slope of log lowest finite eigenvalue vs C for fixed b001 mixture, common N192; both parity blocks must be positive
kappa_prime: OLS negative slope of log normalized squared transform derivative at the lowest pair height, across all six saved N192 negative witnesses b030,b015,b008,b004,b002,b001; display adjacent slopes and transform value as diagnostics
prediction: Anchor C=6015/128 at b=1/1000; slope=2/(kappa-kappa_prime) if positive. If nonpositive or unresolved, explicitly mark mechanism unavailable and use the six-point descriptive model only as fallback, with no mechanism-success claim. No target parameter or trial before fixed forecast JSON.
window_protocol: Complete replayed H160 atlas before each target search. Common N1924096bit trials; start48 and56, expand high to at most128 if needed; bisect to width<=1/32; N256 sensitivity and4352bit witness reconstruction.
stop_rule: If either final mechanism forecast misses its fixed tolerance, or the mechanism is undefined, stop mechanism forecasting and retain log law as descriptive only. No refit or further held-out target.
